tour: Georgia (Batumi): Private Customizable Tour with Guide
en: Our driver and guide Bega told us very interesting stories and helped with advice on what else to see. He always offered a hand where it was hard to get to. We saw everything we had planned ourselves and also the Okatse canyon. The car was comfortable. We saw the Kvatski pillars and the Martvili canyon. It was important for us to get to the Kobuleti market, to the shoemaker, and he helped us get there. We are very grateful and next time we will choose your services.

text: Beqa was wonderful as a driver and tour guide. He spent time with me to build the itinerary before the trip, showed amazing local knowledge about the best places to go, and had made all the arrangements within 24h of our booking. His car was comfortable and spacious, and he was a very safe driver. We visited caves and waterfalls, and even though we had to make some changes on the day as certain elements were closed, he did everything he could to make it the best day possible. His English was incredible and he helped us to bridge the language barrier with anyone who primarily spoke Georgian. He even offered to be available after the trip for further recommendations during our stay in Batumi. Overall it was a 10/10 experience - thank you!
name: Matty
tour: Georgia (Batumi): Private Customizable Tour with Guide
